world.a-purse-for-a-brawler: The tavern wants a champion, and it's put up a purse to prove it. The first adventurer to win a Brawl walks away richer.
world.the-fairies-are-dancing: The fairies are dancing, and lucky rolls are in the air. The first adventurer to roll a pair of sixes catches a fairy's eye, and a fairy's charm.
world.a-ghost-wants-company: Someone in the ruins is lonely. The first adventurer to sit down and rest among the old stones will have a ghostly friend, and a keepsake.
world.taproot-tremors: The ground near the Great Thalowood shivered last night, and the roots are still humming. The next adventurer to conquer the deep forest might find something astonishing in the soil.
world.frog-rain: It's raining frogs. Not metaphorically. They bounce off hats, plop into soup, and some adventurers get a little too close to the transformation.
world.pass-it-on: A mischievous gust snatches every adventurer's map and shuffles them around. Nobody's going quite where they meant to this round.
world.gravity-hiccup: Everything gets slightly floaty. Rocks drift. Swords wobble. Muscles are useless; magic soars.
world.the-giggles: A giggling fit sweeps across Thaloroot and won't stop. Nobody can keep a straight face long enough to pick a fight.
world.squirrel-heist: A blur of tails tears through every camp in Thaloroot at once. When the dust settles, everyone's pack is lighter, and a stash of stolen goods waits somewhere in the forest.
world.shoe-swap: Everyone wakes up wearing someone else's shoes, and carrying something that isn't theirs. Nobody knows how it happened. Nobody ever does.
world.bloom-burst: The roots sigh, and the whole realm sparkles. Thal drifts up from the ground like dandelion fluff, and coins turn up in every pocket.
world.talking-animals: Every animal in Thaloroot can suddenly talk, and they have opinions. Companions lean in close to share what they've overheard about everyone else's quests.
world.the-wandering-door: A door appears in the middle of a field, standing all by itself. It's slightly ajar. Light glows through the crack. Anyone could open it.
world.backwards-day: Everyone wakes up on the wrong side of the Bloom. The sun rises in the west, the rivers run uphill, and everyone takes their turn in the opposite order.
world.thal-hiccup: The magic skips a beat. Every enchanted tool, every grafted gadget, every lucky charm sputters and goes quiet for a round.
world.festival-of-lanterns: Lanterns float up from every village in Thaloroot, filling the sky with warm light. Anyone carrying a light of their own is welcomed like a hero.
world.the-sky-cracks: A crack splits the sky from horizon to horizon, and through it pours light the color of thal. Everything is worth more now. Everything costs more, too.
world.the-dragon-stirs: Deep under the mountain, the Dragon rolls over in its sleep, and every monster in Thaloroot gets bolder. Something very large is waking up.
world.masks-appear: Masks appear on every doorstep overnight: feathered, gilded, smiling. Nobody knows who left them. Nobody can tell who's wearing them.
world.the-roots-tremble: The ground shudders, and the deepest roots of the realm begin to stir. Treasures pulled from the most dangerous places come up heavy with thal.
world.the-gardener-kings-stir: In the ruins, the statues turn their heads. The ghosts of the Gardener-Kings are waking, and they guard their old treasures jealously, but generously reward the brave.
world.the-bloom-peaks: The Bloom reaches its height. Every flower is open, every root is full, and every success in Thaloroot comes with a little extra gold.
world.the-sky-falls: The crack in the sky splits wide, and stars begin to fall across Thaloroot like burning seeds. One last chance to catch one before the Bloom ends.
world.the-dragon-wakes: The mountain splits open, and the Dragon rises into the sky, roaring fire. Every adventurer in the realm turns to face it. This is the last fight of the Bloom.
world.the-midnight-masquerade: At midnight, the masks come off. Every adventurer gathers in the ruins for a grand masquerade, and every secret in the realm is about to be revealed.
world.the-taproot-wakes: The ground splits, and the Taproot itself rises from the deep, glowing and enormous. Anyone brave enough might reach out and touch the heart of all thal.
world.the-last-court: The ghosts of the Gardener-Kings take their thrones one last time and hold court over the realm. They judge every adventurer's haul, and they love a treasure.
world.the-great-harvest: The Bloom bursts into a final, glorious harvest. For one last round, every reward in Thaloroot comes twice.
world.the-bloom-fades: The thal sinks back into the roots, slow and gentle, like a long exhale. Every adventurer feels a last wave of strength for the final turn.
world.last-light: The sun sets on the Bloom, and darkness falls over Thaloroot. Only the lights adventurers carry still shine, and they shine like treasures.
world.the-grand-bazaar: Every merchant in Thaloroot arrives at once for one final, glorious market. The rarest treasures of the Bloom are for sale, one last time.
